breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that the torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. The generated specification correctly states 'Calculate the maximum torsional shear stress at the outer surface from the torque' and includes τxy as the shear stress component in the plane stress state, matching the ground truth which properly uses the torsional shear stress (not zero) in the principal stress calculation.
